title: Primal-Dual Flow Matching for Sample-Wise Constrained Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12699v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the problem of learning to generate data while satisfying a prescribed \emph{sample-wise} constraint with a user-specified probability of constraint satisfaction. Starting with a population-level constrained negative log-likelihood minimization and using a flow-matching (FM) parameterization, under regularity assumptions and sufficient expressivity of the velocity field family, we derive guarantees on the probability of constraint satisfaction for the corresponding primal-dual optimization algorithm. We provide a practical implementation of this approach, called Primal-Dual Flow Matching (PDFM), which has direct control over constraint satisfaction rate and requires only binary membership oracle feedback for constraint satisfaction, avoiding the need for differentiable distances, projections, or special structure of the constraint set, such as convexity. translated_title: 面向逐样本约束生成的原始-对偶流匹配
translated_abstract: 我们考虑在生成数据的同时满足预先指定的逐样本约束的问题，并要求约束满足概率达到用户指定的水平。从总体层面的约束负对数似然最小化出发，采用流匹配参数化，在正则性假设以及速度场函数族具有充分表达能力的条件下，我们为相应的原始-对偶优化算法推导了约束满足概率的理论保证。我们给出了该方法的一个实用实现，称为原始-对偶流匹配，它能够直接控制约束满足率，并且对于约束是否满足仅需二值成员资格谕示反馈，从而无需可微的距离度量、投影操作或约束集的特殊结构（如凸性）。我们证明，PDFM 相比朴素 FM 以及……（摘要在此处被截断）能够提升约束满足率。
tldr: 提出原始-对偶流匹配（PDFM），在流匹配框架中引入原始-对偶优化，仅依靠二值约束满足反馈即可直接控制逐样本约束的满足概率，无需可微距离、投影或凸性等约束集结构假设。
en_tdlr: PDFM is a primal-dual flow matching method that directly controls sample-wise constraint satisfaction probability using only binary membership oracle feedback, without requiring differentiable distances, projections, or special constraint set structure such as convexity.
